Initial release of ai-intelligent-ar-vr-platform.

- Provides a platform for AR and VR application development with immersive experiences.
- Supports AR, VR, 3D scene construction, gesture-based interaction, and multi-user collaboration.
- Offers tiered pricing plans for individual, professional, and enterprise needs.
- Suitable for game development, education, real estate, and industrial simulation.
